  "memo":"Recommend clear under FP-2 §6.6(c). R04 holds, but it is Context only. R01 is excluded by account age; R11, R03, R07, R05, R02, R08, R06(a), R06(b), R10 and R09 do not hold. No adverse family is present, and no household exception is needed. No earlier outcome settles the order, and no checks have completed. The most plausible benign explanation is a new customer's large first purchase with an isolated AVS failure. Stolen-card use remains possible but lacks qualifying evidence. No installments were due, so non-payment cannot support an adverse recommendation. No verification check is required or decision-changing under the applicable policy row."
